SYMPTOM: 'Unable to simultaneously satisfy constraints: UIInputView.height == 261 vs UIView-Encapsulated-Layout-Height == 874'
CAUSE: Keyboard extension sets explicit intrinsicContentSize height at priority .required (1000), which conflicts with the system-injected encapsulated layout height during initial connection
FIX: Set height constraint priority to UILayoutPriority(999):
```swift
// In KeyboardViewController viewDidLoad:
let heightConstraint = view.heightAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 261)
heightConstraint.priority = UILayoutPriority(999)
heightConstraint.isActive = true
```
PREVENT: All keyboard extension height constraints should use priority 999, not .required, to yield to system size changes gracefully.
